paragraphs: Rav Giddel said: “The great God”—he magnified Him by uttering the Explicit Name: Yoma 69b and Sanhedrin. He would sit at the gates of immersion and say, “Immerse thus,” and said that they resembled white geese to him: Berakhot 20a. He was seeking to buy land, but Rabbi Abba bought it; he complained about him before Rabbi Zeira, and Rabbi Zeira brought it to Rabbi Yitzchak Nappacha (see above, Rabbi Abba). He became sterile from Rav Huna’s lectures: Yevamot 64b. Rabbi Zeira was sitting behind Rav Giddel, and Rav Giddel before Rav Huna: Berakhot 49a. He reported Zeira: Menachot 21a and Beitzah chapter 1. In the Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Beitzah chapter 1: Rabbi Zeira in the name of Giddel. He reported Rabbi Chiyya bar Yosef, who reported Rav: Shabbat 7a; Pesachim 7a, and there, 21b. That matter is reported by R. A. b. Y. [אר״א ב״י; referent unresolved] in the name of Rabbi Yochanan in Yevamot 92b. Rav Tavyomi teaches: “Rav Giddel said in the name of Rav”; Rav Kahana teaches: “Rav Giddel said in the name of Shmuel”: Nedarim 16b; Chullin 127a, 3b. Rabbi Yehoshua bar Abba said in the name of Rav Giddel. He reported Rabbi Yochanan: Niddah 24a. Rabbi Yirmeyah bar Abba taught him, and he taught Rav Yehudah. Rav Kahana said in the name of Rav Giddel: Niddah 10a. Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said, “I teach it neither as Giddel bar Menashya nor as bar Minyomi, but simply as Giddel. What practical difference does this make? To raise a contradiction between his own statements”: Pesachim 107, end of side a. He reported Rav: Shabbat 30b; Chagigah 10, end of side a. “By the Torah, the Prophets, and the Writings, Rav said this”: Eruvin 17a, 29a. Rava, son of Rav Huna, said in the name of Rav Giddel, who said in the name of Rav: Kiddushin 42a. “Rav Giddel said in the name of Rava,” Shevuot 49a, is a scribal error; it should read “said in the name of Rav,” and so it is in the newer Talmud editions. He reported Shmuel: Niddah 11b; see above. Rabbi Abba bar Zavda, Rav Acha bar Yaakov, and Rav Sheshet were his colleagues.
